import json
H=W=20
g=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
b_r0,b_r1,b_c0,b_c1=2,8,9,15
ones=[(2,6),(3,19),(4,5),(7,1),(8,19),(12,9),(17,13),(19,15)]
# horizontal per block row: check for 1s left/right of block in that row
for r in range(b_r0,b_r1+1):
    left_block=any(c<b_c0 for (rr,c) in ones if rr==r)
    right_block=any(c>b_c1 for (rr,c) in ones if rr==r)
    c_a = b_c0 if left_block else 0
    c_b = b_c1 if right_block else W-1
    for c in range(c_a,c_b+1): g[r][c]=2
# vertical per block col: 1s above/below
for c in range(b_c0,b_c1+1):
    up=any(r<b_r0 for (r,cc) in ones if cc==c)
    down=any(r>b_r1 for (r,cc) in ones if cc==c)
    r_a = b_r0 if up else 0
    r_b = b_r1 if down else H-1
    for r in range(r_a,r_b+1): g[r][c]=2
for (r,c) in ones: g[r][c]=1
print(json.dumps(g))
